cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
live=json.load(open("nm_live.json"))
with open("nomask_live_keys.txt","w") as f:
    f.write("# nomask — 20 key LIVE (HTTP 200), diuji 2026-11-17\n")
    f.write("# base url: https://api.nomask.ai/v1\n")
    f.write("# WAJIB: force_string_serializer=true (kalau tidak -> error 'content must be a string')\n")
    f.write("# format: email | api_key\n")
    for k,e in live: f.write(f"{e} | {k}\n")
print("tersimpan:",len(live),"key")
PY
